title: vCon Dialog Object
description: A segment of captured conversation (text, audio, video, transfer record, or incomplete attempt)

start.description: Date and time for the beginning of this dialog segment (RFC3339)

duration.description: Duration in seconds of the dialog segment

parties.description: Index or indices of parties contributing to this dialog; for multi-channel recordings, an array whose elements are the party index or indices per channel

originator.description: Index into the parties array for the party that originated this dialog; provided only when the first party listed is NOT the originator

mediatype.description: MIME media type of the dialog content (e.g. 'audio/x-wav', 'text/plain', 'video/x-mp4')

filename.description: Original filename of the dialog file

encoding.description: Encoding applied to the body parameter

url.description: HTTPS URL where the externally referenced dialog file is stored

content_hash.description: Hash(es) of the externally referenced dialog content

disposition.description: Reason the call or conversation setup failed; REQUIRED for 'incomplete' type, SHOULD NOT be present for other types

party_history.description: History of party join/drop/hold/mute events during this dialog

transferee.description: Index into the parties array for the Transferee role; SHOULD be present for 'transfer' type

transferor.description: Index into the parties array for the Transferor role; SHOULD be present for 'transfer' type

transfer-target.description: Index into the parties array for the Transfer Target role; SHOULD be present for 'transfer' type

original.description: Index into the dialog array for the original dialog between Transferee and Transferor; SHOULD be present for 'transfer' type

consultation.description: Index into the dialog array for the consultative dialog between Transferor and Transfer Target; optional for 'transfer' type

target-dialog.description: Index into the dialog array for the target dialog between Transferee and Transfer Target; SHOULD be present for 'transfer' type

campaign.description: Label or foreign key reference to the campaign this dialog is part of

interaction_id.description: Label or foreign key reference to the interaction ID

skill.description: Skill required to service this dialog in a contact center

application.description: Application, communication channel, or context over which the conversation was held

message_id.description: Unique message identifier assigned by the messaging system

ContentHash.description: Single hash token or array of hash tokens for externally referenced content

PartyHistoryObject.description: Record of a join, drop, hold, or mute event for a party during a dialog

party.description: Index into the parties array for the party this event applies to

time.description: Date and time of the event (RFC3339)
